senses.gloss:
नह् नह् (for original नध्), i. 4, Par., Ātm. (also i. 1 or 6, MBh. 1, 1460),
 1. To bind, Bhāg. P. 5, 14, 38.
 2. Ātm. To arm one's self, MBh. 4, 1016.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. नद्ध,
 1. Tied, Rām. 4, 12, 19.
 2. Bound, Rām. 5, 14, 15.
 3. [] Covered, Hariv. 8799.
 4. Joined, Rām. 4, 13, 13.
 5. Laid in, MBh. 2, 1915.
 --With the prep. अप अप, To untie, MBh. 3, 13309.
 --With अपि अपि, or पि पि,
 1. To fasten, MBh. 4, 301; 13, 2352.
 2. To squeeze, Śāk. d. 18.
 3. To cover, Rām. 5, 18, 4. पिनद्ध, Striped, MBh. 13, 976 (इन्द्रायुधपिनद्धाङ्ग, of which the body was adorned by a rainbow, viz. a cloud).
 --With अव अव, अवनद्ध, Covered, Man. 6, 76.
 --With आ आ, Ātm. To be obstructed, Suśr. 2, 369, 10. आनद्ध,
 1. Bound, MBh. 6, 5525.
 2. Obstructed, Suśr. 2, 373, 21
 3. Covered, 1, 22, 3.
 --With व्या वि-आ, व्यानद्ध, Striped (cf. अपि), Hariv. 6884.
 --With उद् उद्,
 1. To press out, Suśr. 1, 301, 9.
 2. To come out, MBh. 3, 11016 (p. 570). उन्नद्ध,
 1. Bound upward, Ragh. 18, 50.
 2. Raised, Bhāg. P. 4, 11, 4.
 3. Unfettered, 4, 27, 4.
 4. Proud, 4, 14, 4.
 5. Arrogant, 7, 10, 26.
 --With समुद् सम्-उद्, समुन्नद्ध,
 1. Unfettered, Bhāg. P. 4, 17, 33.
 2. Pressed out, Suśr. 1, 280, 20.
 3. Excessive, Bhāg. P. 1, 15, 3.
 4. Conceited, MBh. 5, 1000.
 --Comp.
 --With उप उप, उपनद्ध, Laid in, Bhāg. P. 8, 15, 6.
 --Caus. To cause to be dressed (as a wound), Suśr. 2, 109, 18.
 --With परि परि णह् णह्,
 1. To span, MBh. 1, 1406.
 2. To surround, Ṛt. 6, 25. परिणद्ध, Large, Ragh. 3, 34.
 --With पि पि, see अपि.
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To fasten, Bhāg. P. 8, 12, 21.
 2. To dress, MBh. 4, 1220.
 3. To put on, MBh. 218, 7; 3, 14958.
 4. To prepare for, Bhartṛ. 2, 6. संनद्ध,
 1. Tied together, Rājat. 4, 543.
 2. Fastened, MBh. 15, 627.
 3. Bordering, Rām. 1, 38, 21. []
 4. Armed, MBh. 2, 2463.
 5. Accoutred, Hariv. 6402.
 6. Ready, Rājat. 1, 77.
 --With अभिसम् अभि-सम्, अभिसंनद्ध, Armed, MBh. 3, 14883.
 --Cf. Lat. nexus, nectere, nere; νέω, νήθω; O.H.G. nâhan, nâwan; Goth. nêthla; A.S. naedl; Goth. nehv, nehva, nehvis; A.S. neah, nearra, neahst.

नहि न-हि, adv.
 1. For not (non enim), Man. 3, 168.
 2. Not at all, Daśak. in Chr. 187, 23.
 3. न--नहि, Certainly not, Pañc. translation by Benfey, T. i. p. 465, n. 3.
नहुष नहुष, m. The name of an ancient king, Man. 7, 41; of a Nāga, etc.
नाहुष नाहुष, i. e. नहुष + अ, patronym. A son of Nahuṣa, Rām. 3, 23, 24.
नाह नाह, i. e. नह् + अ, m. Obstruction, Suśr. 2, 369, 5.
